text:
raj_partnerships: Uploaded the latest ZIP from Skyline for the co-branded one-pager and marketplace tile. Link: https://drive.redwood/skyline/one-pager.zip :pushpin:
assets_bot: File uploaded by raj_partnerships -> skyline_onepager_v3.pdf (3.2MB)
emma_marketing: skimmed. main ask: can we tighten the quote and shorten hero headline to 8 words? :thinking_face:
marco_design: checked logos — they sent SVG + PNG. note on clearspace: use 1.25x width to the left/right. sample:
```
/* lockup clearspace */
.logo { padding: 1.25 * logo-width; }
```
marco_design: need a 1200x628 hero, PNG-24, and a marketplace thumbnail 600x600, square centered on the product screenshot
lina_legal: quick legal check: quote attribution ok if we have written approval. did we get permission for Skyline logo treatment? @raj_partnerships please confirm
raj_partnerships: we have an email thread but not signed SSO release. pinged their PM, ETA EOD tomorrow
olivia_product: one more thing — solution brief technical callouts mention "dedicated GPU pool" — can we say "reserved GPU capacity" instead? more accurate
emma_marketing: also alt text for marketplace tile: "Skyline + Redwood Inference solution screenshot — AI inference performance dashboard." Lina ok with that?
lina_legal: alt text fine. for the quote we need the exact wording in their email. once we have it, legal signs off
marco_design: pushed updated mock with adjusted logo spacing and new hero. staging preview https://staging.redwood.design/preview/skyline-v3 :eyes:
emma_marketing: thumbs up. I'll trim hero headline and shorten copy for marketplace tile — aiming for <140 chars
raj_partnerships: timeline: finalize assets by tomorrow noon PT to hit marketplace submission on Friday
olivia_product: I'll review the technical paragraph and post edits in thread
emma_marketing: if everyone is good, can we approve by 12pm tomorrow? :thumbsup:
assets_bot: Reminder: marketplace submission form requires: PDF, hero PNG, thumbnail PNG, alt text, 2-sentence description, signed quote consent. Deadline 2027-04-02 23:59 UTC
marco_design: added the alt text to the image metadata
lina_legal: noted — I'll put the quote consent template in the folder: https://drive.redwood/legal/consent-template.docx
raj_partnerships: thanks team — will follow up with Skyline PM and update here
